upload.title: Scan your receipt
upload.support: Take a photo or choose a receipt image. We’ll read the items with Open Prices and score them with Open Food Facts.
upload.error: Could not upload this receipt. Try another photo.

review.title: Adjust receipt
review.fetchAllHint: Fetch Open Food Facts data first so you can confirm products, fix barcodes, and contribute accurately.
review.fetchAllMissing: Add at least one barcode first.
review.fetchAllResult: Updated {matched} of {total} barcodes from Open Food Facts.
review.fetchAllError: Could not fetch products from Open Food Facts. Try again.
review.locationHint: Search OpenStreetMap for the store. Needed to contribute prices.
review.locationNoResults: No matching shops found. You can still score this receipt.
review.locationError: Could not search OpenStreetMap. Try again.
review.contributeEnabledHint: Shop recognized — you can share these prices with Open Prices after verifying items.
review.contributeDisabledHint: Without a recognized shop location you still get Nutri-Score analysis, but you cannot contribute prices.
review.contributeSendHint: Share confirmed prices with Open Prices. Needs a shop and a date; each price is sent once.
review.contributeAlreadySent: Already sent {count} confirmed prices. Confirm another product to send more.
review.contributeNeedLocation: Select a recognized shop location first.
review.contributeNeedVerified: Verify all items before contributing ({pending} still need review).
review.contributeNothingToSend: No verified barcode or category items to send.
review.contributeSuccess: Sent {sent} of {total} prices to Open Prices.
review.contributePartial: Sent {sent} of {total} prices. {failed} failed — check your connection and try again.
review.contributeError: Could not send prices to Open Prices. Try again.
review.itemsTapHint: Tap an item to edit barcode, category, price and quantity. Swipe left to delete.
review.subtitle: Check each item, then continue to your score.
review.tapToAddBarcode: Tap to add barcode or category
review.locationInfoNeeded: Pick the shop to enable sending prices to Open Prices.
review.locationInfoOk: Shop recognized — you can send prices after confirming items.
review.name: Product name
review.nameMismatchHint: Receipt text and photo may not match — check the barcode.
review.barcodeCorrectHint: Enter or scan the correct barcode, then look it up.
review.noBarcodeHint: Fresh or bulk items often have no barcode. Pick a category, or confirm that no barcode is available.
review.noBarcodeConfirmed: Marked as no barcode — pick and confirm a category to verify
review.categoryHint: Open Food Facts categories — type a few letters to filter the list.
review.categoryImageError: Category confirmed, but no photo was found on Open Food Facts.
review.productPhotoHint: Optional — add your own product photo to help confirm the match.
review.productPhotoError: Could not read that image. Try another photo.
review.productPhotoTooLarge: Photo is too large. Choose an image under 5 MB.
review.useBarcodeInstead: Enter or scan a barcode instead
review.scanBarcodeHelp: Point your camera at the barcode, or choose a photo of it.
review.scanReady: Camera ready — hold a barcode in the frame.
review.scanNoCamera: No camera found. Use a photo, or type the barcode.
review.scanCameraError: Could not open the camera. Allow camera access, or use a photo instead.
review.scanPhotoError: No barcode found in that photo. Try another image or type the code.
review.empty: No items yet. Scan a receipt or load the sample list.
review.emptyCaptured: No items were read from this receipt. Add them below.
review.contributeNeedsProof: Prices can only be contributed from a receipt uploaded to Open Prices.
review.contributeNeedsDate: Add the receipt date before contributing prices.
review.contributeNoLines: Each contributed line needs a price and a barcode or category.
review.contributeError: Could not save prices to Open Prices. Check the lines and try again.
review.saveDraftHint: Save this receipt and items on this device. Open History anytime to resume editing.
review.saveDraftError: Could not save the draft. Check browser storage and try again.
review.saveScoredError: Could not save this receipt locally before scoring. Try again.
review.nextHint: Continue when you are done adjusting items. This also saves the receipt in History as scored.

history.title: Receipt history
history.subtitle: Drafts and scored receipts saved on this device. Filter fast, then reopen to adjust or view the score.
history.empty: No saved receipts yet. Capture a receipt, then save a draft or continue to score.
history.loadError: Could not load History from this device.

score.teamNote: Pair C: show Nutri-Score and related scores from the session items.

signIn.tagline: See the nutrition and climate story behind every grocery run.
signIn.detail: Sign in once, scan a receipt, and review Nutri-Score, Eco-Score, and CO₂ for the products you bought.
signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.support: Sign in with your Open Food Facts account to continue.
signIn.usernameHint: Use your user id, not your email address.
signIn.createAccount: Create one on Open Food Facts

errors.generic: Sign in failed. Check your username and password.
errors.network: Could not reach Open Prices. Check your connection and try again.
